title: TurkItems
description: This resourcepack changes the item names (not all of 'em) to Türkçe (Turkish names)!
body:
## ⚠️ WARNING: THIS MOD ONLY WORKS IF YOU SELECT "TURKISH" IN THE LANGUAGE SELECTION MENU

# TURK ITEMS
This resourcepack changes the item names to actual Turkish (Türkçe) names. Such as:

Oak Planks -> Normal Tahta :p

Iron Sword -> Orta Seviye Kılıç

Netherite Sword -> OP Kılıç

# 📖 ABOUT THIS MOD
Change names of items, blocks, even structures!

Turns snapshot item names like "Yellow wool stairs" to their Turkish (Türkçe) names.

# Frequently Asked Questions

<details>
<summary>What if I don't like the stone item names?</summary>
Well, you can just don't use the pack. The pack is for the people that like the names of the items.
</details>

<details>
<summary>The pack doesn't work!</summary>
There's bunch of reasons why it couldn't work.
Try these;

  
-   Changing your Minecraft language to Türkçe (Turkish),
  
-   Using the correct Minecraft version (26.1.2 for example).

But if the pack doesn't show up entirely, make sure you put it in the "resourcepacks" folder in the ".minecraft" folder.


</details>
